connector.name: agent4.io
connector.registryDescription: Build and run grounded business agents over MCP: agents, knowledge bases, skills, Storylines.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.agent4.io over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.agent4, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
